title: Force the SCCM software inventory
description: Collect the software inventory now and send it to the SCCM server
notes: Schedule ID {02} = Software Inventory Cycle. The software inventory collects information about installed files and applications.

fr.title: Forcer l'inventaire logiciel SCCM

fr.notes: Schedule ID {02} = Software Inventory Cycle. L'inventaire logiciel collecte les informations sur les fichiers et applications installés.
